description_en: Queries the available actions, including atomic actions and cloud product actions
description_zh: 查询可用动作，包括原子动作和云产品动作
kebab_example: aliyun oos list-actions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --oos-action-name MyTemplate --max-results 50 --next-token - --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListActions

parameters.help_en: The name of the action. All actions whose names contain the specified action name are returned
parameters.help_zh: 动作名称。名称未包含关系，最终列出包含所填动作名称的所有动作
parameters.name: oos_action_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 20 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

ActionType.description_en:
The type of the action.

Atomic actions

    *   Atomic.API
    *   Atomic.Trigger
    *   Atomic.Control
    *   Atomic.Embedded

Cloud product actions

    *   Product.ECS
    *   Product.RDS
    *   Product.VPC
    *   Product.FC
    *
ActionType.description_zh:
动作类型。

原子动作
    - Atomic.API
    - Atomic.Trigger
    - Atomic.Control
    - Atomic.Embedded
云产品动作
    - Product.ECS
    - Product.RDS
    - Product.VPC
    - Product.FC
    - …

CreatedDate.description_en: The time when the action was created

Popularity.description_en: The number of times that the action is used

Properties.example: { "ImageId": { "Description": "The mirror ID you will use when resetting the system", "Type": "String" }, "InstanceId": { "Description": "the instance id that you will handle .", "Type": "String" } }

TemplateVersion.description_en:
The version of the template that corresponds to the action.

For atomic actions, this parameter is not returned
TemplateVersion.description_zh:
动作所对应的模板版本。

对于原子动作，该字段不返回

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
